description: This file defines interfaces and associated data structures for grain testing in an Orleans-based project, including enums, structs, and interface method signatures.

classes.name: ReturnCode
classes.description: An enum representing success (OK) or failure (Fail) status codes.

classes.name: MemberVariables
classes.description: A serializable struct holding a byte array, a string, and a return code, used to transfer multiple related data items.

classes.name: IGeneratorTestGrain
classes.description: An interface for an Orleans grain that provides methods for setting and getting member variables and other test-related operations.

methods.name: ByteSet
methods.description: Sets the byte array data in the grain.

methods.name: StringSet
methods.description: Sets a string value in the grain.

methods.name: StringIsNullOrEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the stored string is null or empty.

methods.name: GetMemberVariables
methods.description: Retrieves the current member variables from the grain.

methods.name: SetMemberVariables
methods.description: Updates the grain's member variables with provided data.
